text:
Maria L: Quick sync — idea: add a lightweight 'Pinboard' for per-route saved queries. shows top-3 telemetry metrics (p50/p95 latency, error rate) inline and adds a quicksave button for the active filter set. would help support and SRE triage.
Devin K: curious — is this a visual layer only or do we need new backend endpoints for the telemetry summary?
Maria L: visual + tiny backend: we already have per-route metrics API but payload is heavy. proposal: endpoint that returns summary tiles for a route+view: {p50,p95,err,requests,lastUpdated}. lightweight and cacheable.
Sanjay P: fine, but need to define TTL and caching keys. if every console view calls this on load we could N+1 our metrics cluster. suggest aggregation tier with 60s TTL and route+filter hash key.
Elaine Z: UX note — Pinboard should be opt-in per user and collapse by default. design mock: https://figma.com/file/xyz (wip). quicksave icon should mirror bookmarks but show telemetry badge.
Chris T: telemetry team: small endpoint OK. we can precompute p50/p95/error in the metrics pipeline as a derived timeseries and serve the last point. cost estimate: ~2 additional writes per minute per route shard.
Devin K: on frontend: quicksave flow = capture current filter set + model selection + slots. one-click saves to saved-queries table. API sketch: POST /routes/{id}/pinboard \nPayload: ```{ "view_hash": "...", "label": "string", "pinned": true }```
Maria L: ownership: product owns UX, frontend owns API surface, telemetry team provides the summary endpoint, platform/SRE sets cache policy. rollout plan — feature flag gated, opt-in beta for internal support first.
Sanjay P: needs rate limits: 100 reqs/min per route by default. we'll surface quota errors as 429 so console can show fallback.
Elaine Z: fallback UI when summary not available: show skeleton tiles with "summary unavailable" and a CTA to refresh. keep interactions non-blocking.
Devin K: implementation Q: do we store pinboard entries in saved-queries table or new pinboard table? storing in saved-queries is easier for reuse, but pinboard needs per-route ordering. thoughts?
Chris T: analytics perspective: if we reuse saved-queries table, add route_id + position column. keeps tooling minimal.
Maria L: agree — reuse saved-queries, add metadata fields. we can mark type=pinboard for special rendering.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag-service v3.4 -> staging (sha: c9f1a2b).
Sanjay P: final ask: doc the cache key, TTL, rate limits in platform.confluence so infra can monitor. I'll draft and ping here.
Maria L: thanks — I’ll coordinate a short RFC with mockups and an API contract. target: internal beta next sprint. :thumbsup:
